title: Upcoming Ramadan Series: For Every Believing Heart
description:
Do you feel distant from Allah? So much so that your heart feels hollow to the point it never settles, or hard and heavy to the point you feel you can barely carry it in your chest?

This Ramadan, you have a chance to take it back to its Creator.

Join us every night of Ramadan for a deeply personal series led by Ustadh Muhammad Tim Humble.

Thirty nights.
Thirty reflections.
For every kind of believing, Muslim heart.

Whether you’re struggling to become better, feel far away, or are trying to find your way back, these reminders are a gentle call to breathe again, to return to Allah with sincerity, and to remember that He never abandoned you. That He is willing to accept you.

So don’t despair in the Mercy of your Rabb.

Come. Be reminded and repent.

Nothing is too broken for Him to restore
